candidate.title: MindMemOS: A Portable and Self-Evolving Memory Operating Layer for AI Agents

published_claim.scope: The arXiv abstract reports that MindSkillEvolve improves SpreadsheetBench success by 9.2 percentage points over the initial-skill baseline. The pinned official README reports SpreadsheetBench-Verified (400 tasks): Init-skill 48.0% +/- 1.4%, MindEvolve-Unsup 55.3% +/- 0.9%, and MindEvolve-Sup 57.2% +/- 2.4%.

official_artifact_support.scope: The pinned repository contains a SpreadsheetBench environment/evaluator, benchmark CLI arguments with dataset URL and deterministic default shuffle seed, and a real FastAPI skill-evolution client. The client registers staged skills, records completed rollouts as injected skill traces, calls /v1/skills/evolve, and writes any minted version back into the local skill directory for subsequent batches. This supports the existence of the claimed execution mechanism but does not reproduce the headline success rates.

independent_replication.scope: Targeted web searches for MindMemOS SpreadsheetBench reproduction, benchmark reproduction, independent reproduction, and arXiv 2608.12428 reproduction located the official repository/paper, derivative tutorials/reviews that repeat official benchmark values, and an unrelated production-readiness surface benchmark. No source found in these searches reported an independent numerical rerun of the MindSkillEvolve SpreadsheetBench-Verified result. This is a bounded search result, not proof of nonexistence.

failed_replication.scope: No source found in the targeted searches reported a failed independent numerical reproduction of the pinned MindSkillEvolve SpreadsheetBench result.

missing_dependencies_or_config.scope: The repository supplies Python version constraints, workspace packaging, a uv.lock at the pinned tree, benchmark dataset download defaults, agent model/API parameters, evolution service URL/API parameters, and evolution batching controls. Exact numerical reproduction still requires external LLM access and a MindMemOS evolution service, and this audit did not establish that repository defaults exactly match the model/service/configuration used for the reported paper table. The pinned test file inspected for shared skill runners only verifies runner dispatch; it is not a numerical benchmark reproduction.

o_specific_adaptation.scope: This audit evaluates the original/public MindMemOS artifact and reported benchmark only. It does not evaluate any O-specific adaptation.

artifact_observations: The pinned README gives the exact reported 400-task SpreadsheetBench-Verified table and links the dataset artifact.
The pinned skills/evolve/algo.py implements a concrete online path from injected rollout traces to /v1/skills/evolve and restaging a newly minted skill version.
The pinned skills/args.py exposes --evolve, --evolve-every, evolution service credentials, dataset URL, seed, model/base-url/API-key, temperature, max tokens and max turns.
The pinned repository contains SpreadsheetBench data/env/evaluator modules and a dependency lockfile, improving artifact completeness relative to a paper-only claim.

The specific shared skill-runner test inspected exercises dispatch only; this audit did not exhaustively classify every test in the repository and does not infer absence of other unit/integration coverage.
scope_limitations: No benchmark execution was performed in this audit.
No claim is made that independent reproduction does not exist; only that none was located in the searched sources on 2026-08-26.
Official artifact support is not treated as independent reproduction.
A production-readiness benchmark of the public service is not treated as reproduction of the paper's SpreadsheetBench result.

The worker's observation about absence of a held-out acceptance gate in the inspected online mint path is retained as a separate artifact-level observation and is not generalized to unpublished services or the full paper experiment configuration.

downstream_use.rule: Use only with exact source-qualified candidate identity and within the scopes above. Do not convert not-located replication evidence into contradiction or failure evidence.

exact_next_action: Inspect the paper appendix and pinned experiment/config paths for the exact SpreadsheetBench model, batch count/evolve-every setting, service-side evolution configuration, repeated-run seeds and checkpoint-selection procedure; then determine whether the public pinned artifact can reproduce the 48.0/55.3/57.2 table without undocumented settings. If credentials/runtime permit in a later bounded audit, run a small non-claiming smoke reproduction before considering a full 400-task numerical rerun.
